_comment: TDD M4 slice: per-route dialect override. Current Go build rejects explicit different dialect at --validate-config (milestone 4+); HTTP expectations below describe the contracted egress (provider-owned auth, dest-keyed URL/headers/classification). Native (dest == ingress) bodies pass through byte-identical.
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.anth]
dialect = "anthropic"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "anth-secret"
session_header = "x-affinity"
session_prompt_cache_key = true
[providers.anth.litellm_kwargs]
headers = { "X-Legacy" = "legacy-kh" }
extra_headers = { "X-Legacy-Extra" = "legacy-extra" }

[[models]]
name = "rd-ns"
provider = "anth"
model = "rd-up"
dialect = "openai-chat"
name: m4_route_dialect_anthropic_default_chat_native_affinity
